summary: Standards: the round-2 evidence for all 15 relay scenarios (impl-relay, evidence_sha a54e36a6, worktree_dirty true) is one free-text ref 'cargo test --workspace --locked (...)' with no report and no bound case, where round 1 bound a junit report and the named test per scenario. Nothing ties a scenario to the test that proves it (e.g. subject.lifecycle.57 now has two tests, the dashboard leg of 52 is a bun test), and a review pins only the verdict, so a later edit or deletion of a bound test never stales the review. I ran the named tests myself (relay_approval 13, divergence_accept 10, brief_format 26, status 29, brief_scope 16, dashboard_briefs 19, canon-gate 242; bun briefs-render 24) and they pass, so I sign; the implementer should rebind with --report junit and --report-case per scenario, and from a clean tree. Blast radius: the whole 0.32 relay scenario set.
